en_version: The Targum of Jonathan ben Uzziel, trans. J. W. Etheridge, London, 1862
he: וּקְרָא יְיָ לִנְהוֹרָא יְמָמָא וְעַבְדֵהּ לְמִפְלַח בֵּיהּ דַיְירֵי עַלְמָא וְלַחֲשׁוֹכָא קָרָא לֵילְיָא וְעַבְדֵיהּ לְמֵינַח בֵּיהּ בִּרְיָיתָא וַהֲוָה רְמַשׁ וַהֲוָה צְפַר יוֹמָא חָד
en: And the Lord called the light Day; and He made it that the inhabiters of the world might labour by it: and the darkness called He night; and He made it that in it the creatures might have rest. And it was evening, and it was morning, the First Day.
